title: Asus may have made its last phone
summary: Asus chairman Jonney Shih told Taiwan's Inside that the company is done making phones for now, marking the end of its Zenfone and ROG Phone lines. "Asus will no longer add new mobile phone models in the future," Shih reportedly said (translated with Google Translate). He didn't entirely rule out a return though, instead saying […]

title: Taiwanese media: Asus Chair Jonney Shih says the company won't release any new smartphones in 2026, which may signal the brand's exit from the Android market (James Peckham/PCMag)
summary: James Peckham /PCMag:Taiwanese media: Asus Chair Jonney Shih says the company won't release any new smartphones in 2026, which may signal the brand's exit from the Android market—  Asus won't release any new smartphones in 2026, and that may signal the brand's exit from the Android space altogether.

title: Asus confirms its smartphone business is on indefinite hiatus
summary: Asus chairman Jonney Shih sees AI applications as the company's main focus going forward.
